title: Catalog: analytes
purpose: Find measured substances/properties and see how their test definitions are used. An analyte is requestable through a test definition.

sections.title: Access and navigation
paragraphs: Active staff with a laboratory role can read the lists. Client portal accounts cannot. Only the admin role creates or edits catalog records.

items.label: Tests
items.description: Combinations of analyte, method version and matrix available for requesting work.

items.label: Methods
items.description: Laboratory method versions that tests and batches refer to.

items.label: Analytes
items.description: Substances or properties measured by tests.

items.label: New analyte
items.description: Administrators create an analyte before defining tests for it.

items.label: Analyte row link
items.description: Administrators open its edit form; other staff see a plain name.

items.label: Spreadsheet import
items.description: Administrators can also create or change many analytes at once from a CSV file under Setup → Spreadsheet import, with a row-by-row preview and the same checks, locks and history as this form.

items.label: Search
items.description: Searches name and CAS number.

items.label: Group
items.description: Inline filter: one analyte group from the fixed list. Analytes with Not recorded match only when the filter is blank.

items.label: Tests
items.description: Has tests requires at least one active or inactive definition. No tests yet requires none.

items.label: Requested on samples
items.description: More filters: Yes requires a received requested test through any definition of this analyte; No requires none.

items.label: Analyte
items.description: Unique substance/property name; default sort is name ascending.

items.label: CAS number
items.description: Optional chemical identifier, or a dash.

items.label: Group
items.description: Analyte group recorded on the analyte, or a dash when not recorded. Sortable by its stored value, so the order follows the internal choice value rather than the displayed name.

items.label: Active tests
items.description: Active definitions out of all definitions for the analyte, regardless of method availability.

items.label: Requested on samples
items.description: Initially hidden count of received requests across the analyte’s definitions.

sections.title: Using the table
paragraphs: Invalid filters leave the table empty with errors until corrected or cleared. A no-match state differs from an empty catalog. Administrators see the relevant New action in an empty catalog.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Combines search and filters across all records and starts at page 1. Search is case-insensitive and matches contained text.

items.label: More filters
items.description: Opens additional criteria and stays open when they are used or invalid.

items.label: Clear all and filter chips
items.description: Clear all restores the unfiltered URL and default sort. Removing one chip clears that criterion and starts at page 1 while keeping the other criteria.

items.label: Column headings
items.description: Linked headings sort the full filtered set; record ID breaks ties. Unsupported sort values fall back to the default.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show, hide or reorder optional columns; the identifying column stays visible. Preferences belong to this browser. Reset restores the default presentation without changing records or filters.

items.label: Rows per page and pagination
items.description: Choose 25, 50 or 100 rows; use Show if automatic submission is unavailable. A size change starts at page 1. First, Previous, Next and Last preserve filters and sort; the result count describes the filtered set.

items.label: Column checkboxes
items.description: Changes apply immediately. Check to show an optional column or uncheck to hide it. Always shown columns are fixed.

items.label: Move column up / down
items.description: Moves an optional column within the displayed order; the first/last position disables the unavailable move. You can also drag movable table headers.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restores this table’s default order and visibility in this browser.

items.label: Done / Close
items.description: Closes the dialog; layout changes have already been applied and saved locally. No laboratory record is changed.
